dominance_score: (2B-A)/(A+abs(2B)+1e-15); positive values mean realized alignment benefit dominates adjustment cost
common_break_method: single pooled mean break in the six model-by-window dominance-score series; each series is centered and scaled by its full-sample standard deviation; choose the candidate maximizing pooled within-series SSE reduction

null_bootstrap.method: joint circular moving-block bootstrap of centered six-variate observations under no break

break_date_interval_bootstrap.method: joint circular moving-block bootstrap of residuals centered separately within the two fitted regimes, with fitted regime means restored

scope: Retrospective exploratory cross-model break analysis of already observed 2000-2019 A/B components. It verifies the new tree archive and summarizes all three models, but does not convert the estimated break date into a real-time trading rule or a confirmatory structural-break claim.
claim_boundary: The global bootstrap p-value is exploratory because the statistic and full 2000-2019 sample are used to select the break. A confirmatory claim requires a separately locked rule tested on untouched later outcomes; 2020-2025 outcomes remain inaccessible in this run.
